name: Introduction to Metrology
description:
Introduction to metrology, elements of engineering measurement, line and end standards, limits, fits and tolerances- interchangeability, selective assembly, Indian standard specifications, limit gauging- Taylor’s principles of limit gauging, types of comparators- mechanical, optical, pneumatic and electric comparators, angular measurements- protractors, sine bar, angle gauges, optical instruments for angular measurements- auto collimators and interferometers.
Measurement of surface finish using experimental methods, measurement of screw threads, thread gauges for internal and external threads, gear inspection.
Feature inspection- straightness, flatness, parallelism, squareness, circularity and roundness using Coordinate Measuring Machine and Vision Measuring Machine.
